name: 49001 · Kalamazoo, MI
findings: ZIP 49001 (Kalamazoo) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49001 (Kalamazoo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49001 (Kalamazoo) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.
